summary: I mean I can't shake the vision from my head... What it must look like for a seven year old to die of thirst. While all these adults with guns and badges do nothing and let you die. Talking about cup of water. #mb A cup of water is too much humanity to show a child?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I mean I can't shake the vision from my head... What it must look like for a seven year old to die of thirst. While all these adults with guns and badges do nothing and let you die.

Talking about cup of water. #mb

A cup of water is too much humanity to show a child?
